Most alarmingly, TSLA's valuation is wildly overextended, with a negative margin of safety of -92.44%, making it prohibitively expensive relative to its intrinsic value of ~$105 billion. Combined with its underperformance (-12.35% over 3 months, -10.53% YTD), TSLA is a classic example of a low-quality, overvalued business with no compelling reason to own it. Avoid or short with high conviction.
